findings.description: Looking through the doorway from 00:06 to 00:07, the far white door has a six-pane glass window and a tall vertical opening/frame on the wall to its right. As the camera moves forward between 00:08 and 00:09, the door's glass grid morphs into a covered panel and the tall opening to the right turns into a solid wall with a small black-framed picture.

After the woman turns right from the kitchen into the bedroom (00:03–00:05) and turns left inside the bedroom (00:06), the framed floral print and countertop from the kitchen inexplicably appear inside the bedroom to the left of the doorway at 00:07, and walking through the doorway (00:08–00:09) puts her back into a duplicate kitchen with cabinets, microwave, and stove that were not visible through the doorway at 00:06–00:07.
As the woman walks toward the doorway at 00:08, a distorted flesh-colored duplicate forearm/hand briefly appears just to the left of her left arm before vanishing at 00:09.
